irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01(8), (22), (30) - each clause grants a greater-of dollar/EBITDA-percentage base PLUS 'any Investment capacity available under' the other two clauses
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: Represent a reciprocal, circular unused-capacity-sharing arrangement among three (or more) sibling baskets, where each basket's total capacity = its own base + whatever is currently unused under its siblings (which themselves depend on this basket's own usage).
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: WireSharedCapacity assumes one static aggregate ceiling shared by members drawing down a common pool; LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE assumes a reference to usage against such a pool. Neither expresses a circular graph of three independently-based baskets that each donate/receive unused room from the others without double counting.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: A RECIPROCAL_CAPACITY_POOL node type that models N member baskets each with its own base capacity expression, where each member's effective capacity is its base plus the sum of (other members' base minus other members' usage), computed transactionally rather than statically.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01(27) - '...(B) the First Lien Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the then most recently ended Test Period' / '...(B) the Interest Coverage Ratio level as of the last day of the then most recently ended Test Period'
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: Compare a pro forma metric value against the SAME metric's own actual (non-pro-forma) value as of a floating prior measurement date, as an alternative 'no worse than current' test.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: DURING_PERIOD is designed for period-scoped aggregation of a value, not for pinning a metric to its actual (non-hypothetical) historical measurement as a comparator baseline distinct from a pro forma calculation of the same metric name.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: A PRIOR_ACTUAL_SNAPSHOT node (operand: METRIC_REFERENCE, periodDescription) explicitly denoting the metric's last actual (non-pro-forma) determination, usable as a COMPARE operand distinct from a current pro forma METRIC_REFERENCE of the same name.

sharedCapacities.description: Reciprocal cross-basket capacity: unused Investment capacity under Permitted Investments clauses (8) [Similar Business Investments], (22) [Unrestricted Subsidiary Investments], and (30) [Joint Venture Investments] is each expressly available to, and drawable by, the other two clauses' baskets ('plus any Investment capacity available under clauses (X) and (Y)').

capExpression.semanticDescription: a dynamic, reciprocal 'available capacity' add-on shared circularly among three sibling baskets, each of which also feeds the other two
capExpression.reason: The IR's shared-capacity primitive models a single static ceiling shared among members; this text instead grants each of three baskets its own independent greater-of base PLUS access to whatever capacity remains unused under the other two, which is circular (each basket's 'available' amount depends on the others' usage) and has no closed-form ceiling value stated in the text.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01(8), (22), (30) - each clause grants a greater-of dollar/EBITDA-percentage base PLUS 'any Investment capacity available under' the other two clauses
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: Represent a reciprocal, circular unused-capacity-sharing arrangement among three (or more) sibling baskets, where each basket's total capacity = its own base + whatever is currently unused under its siblings (which themselves depend on this basket's own usage).
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: WireSharedCapacity assumes one static aggregate ceiling shared by members drawing down a common pool; LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE assumes a reference to usage against such a pool. Neither expresses a circular graph of three independently-based baskets that each donate/receive unused room from the others without double counting.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: A RECIPROCAL_CAPACITY_POOL node type that models N member baskets each with its own base capacity expression, where each member's effective capacity is its base plus the sum of (other members' base minus other members' usage), computed transactionally rather than statically.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §1.01(27) - '...(B) the First Lien Leverage Ratio as of the last day of the then most recently ended Test Period' / '...(B) the Interest Coverage Ratio level as of the last day of the then most recently ended Test Period'
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: Compare a pro forma metric value against the SAME metric's own actual (non-pro-forma) value as of a floating prior measurement date, as an alternative 'no worse than current' test.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: DURING_PERIOD is designed for period-scoped aggregation of a value, not for pinning a metric to its actual (non-hypothetical) historical measurement as a comparator baseline distinct from a pro forma calculation of the same metric name.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: A PRIOR_ACTUAL_SNAPSHOT node (operand: METRIC_REFERENCE, periodDescription) explicitly denoting the metric's last actual (non-pro-forma) determination, usable as a COMPARE operand distinct from a current pro forma METRIC_REFERENCE of the same name.

overallNotes: Scope decision: given the frozen inventory flags only clauses (8), (13)/General Basket Amount, (15), (22), (27) and (30) as CRITICAL quantitative/conditional components, and no deterministic quantitative value was detected outside those six clauses, the remaining 24 purely categorical clauses of the 'Permitted Investments' definition (clauses (1)-(7), (9)-(12), (14), (16)-(21), (23)-(26), (28)-(29)) were preserved within the top-level 'Permitted Investments' WireDefinition (d-pi) rather than separately modeled as individual quantitative WireRules, since they impose no stated dollar cap or ratio gate.

Several categorical clauses cross-reference other covenant sections (6.01, 6.01(b)(10), 6.02, 6.05, 6.08, 6.08(a)(3), 5.16, 5.18(b) and enumerated sub-clauses thereof) that Phase 2's region retrieval reported as OUT_OF_SCOPE due to source-context budget exhaustion; these are noted only as unresolved dependencies in d-pi's sufficiencyReasons and were not independently re-fetched because they do not affect the economics of the six CRITICAL inventory items.

The dependency-context definitions of Consolidated EBITDA, First Lien Leverage Ratio, Interest Coverage Ratio, Joint Venture, Unrestricted Subsidiary and Similar Business were used only to interpret metric names and gating logic in the compiled rules, per their READ-ONLY status; no WireDefinition or inventory claim was made against them.

The Consolidated EBITDA definition region was itself reported TRUNCATED_AT_BUDGET; because Consolidated EBITDA is referenced here only by METRIC_REFERENCE name (not recomputed), this truncation does not affect the sufficiency of rules r-8/r-13/r-15/r-22/r-30, but any future compilation of the Consolidated EBITDA definition itself should not be treated as COMPLETE from this bundle alone.
